outcome: admission to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: 400 women who delivered at a university hospital in Riyadh
finding: Maternal anemia was associated with adverse events in mothers, such as postpartum hemorrhage, and in neonates, such as congenital malformations, low birth weight, and higher admissions to the NICU.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was associated with maternal anemia
